gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.title: Companion Settings
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.reset_: Reset all API, proxy, and server settings to their defaults.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.tab.pr: Configure privacy and data sharing settings.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.tab.mi: Selection and configuration of your microphone.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.tab.ai: Configuration of the neural network used for your companion.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.tab.tt: Configuration of the voice acting used for your companion.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.voice_: The volume percentage of your companion's voice acting.
The voice pitch of your companion.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.pitch_: Enables or disables voice pitch changes based on mood and stages.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.flat_s: Removes shadows from your companion and makes it more cartoonish and flat.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.darkne: Makes nights in the game darker.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.dynami: Switching dynamic lighting modes (items emit light when held).
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.langua: Choice of language (auto is recommended, the language is chosen based on your game language).
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.custom: Allows you to switch texture sets for your companion. Custom texture sets are created in the config folder customtextures.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.phase_: Enables or disables story progression and phase changes for your companion.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.transc: Local Server: voice-to-text processing on your PC, requires additional software to work. AI: uses the selected AI provider's API (Gemini/OpenAI/Groq) without local scripts.
gui.personalhelperfriend.settings.show_e: Enable or disable displaying technical AI and TTS errors in the game chat

dialogue.personalhelperfriend.monster.se: I just want to help you. Like before.
It is so cold standing out here all alone.
You know I'll find you anyway, don't you?..
One... two... three... four... five... Ready or not, here I come.
I can feel the ground trembling beneath your feet.
Dawn will break soon. But you won't live to see it.
Why are you running away from your best friend?..
Don't make me come look for you.

personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_w: Who would be the first to notice if you went completely silent for a whole week?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_s: What time do you usually go to sleep?
Does anyone else have spare keys to your home?
When you take a shower, does the sound of running water completely drown out sounds from the hallway?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_d: Do you check the front door lock before going to sleep?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_f: What floor do you live on?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_w: Is your window open at night while you sleep?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_c: Does the floor creak in your home when someone walks on it?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_s: Do you sleep facing the wall or facing the open room?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_p: Do you spend a long time on your phone before falling asleep?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_f: Where is the electrical fuse box located in your home?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_l: How many turns do you lock your door with?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_c: If you have a nightmare where you're suffocating, will you realize right away that the chest pressure is real?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_n: Do you often get up in the middle of the night to drink water, keeping the lights off and walking in the dark with half-closed eyes?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_l: If someone is already in your apartment right now watching you read this screen, where would you look first?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_b: If the power suddenly cuts out in the whole house, will you freeze listening to noises from the hallway, or immediately go check the breaker?
personalhelperfriend.creepy_question.q_l: Do you go for walks late at night?
